A layer that lives in its OWN repository also declares `remote` (its clone URL, https, ending .git) and optionally `branch` (default main): that is what makes a guest hold a second checkout of it at `path`, pinned to its own commit beside the core's (`--layer-ref`, #3395). A layer with no `remote` is inside the core checkout and a guest needs nothing more. Read through `src/layer-checkouts.mjs`, never by hand.
